findings.rootCause: The controlled blocked override carried nextReason "No canonical task is ready." — an absolute readiness claim. The same render pass labels T001 "Ready by recorded task dependencies" from readinessText(), so one viewport asserted a fact and its negation. The mock already separates the two concepts in task detail ("Dependency readiness is not permission to run it"); only the Next reason used the wrong word.
findings.change: The blocked override now states what the example withholds — an execution action — and the shared "No next step" branch derives a dependency-readiness caption from the same taskDataFor() read the rows use, so the two cannot drift. No execution-readiness engine, no glyph or task-data mutation, no Work-admission or live-agent claim.
findings.alsoChecked: The generic fallback literal in the same branch was the identical unsupported claim (currently unreachable: all 62 snapshot records supply their own nextReason). Replaced with "No next execution step is recorded for this record."
